heroHeadline: Polish F-16s Intercept Russian Il-20 Near Ustka — 10th Baltic Intercept of 2026
heroSubtitle: Polish fighter jets intercepted Russian Il-20 reconnaissance aircraft over the Baltic Sea near Łeba (Aug 31) and Ustka (Sep 3) without any airspace violation — the 9th and 10th such intercepts of 2026 — prompting Defence Minister Władysław Kosiniak-Kamysz to expand F-16 and helicopter patrols. Separately, NATO scrambled fighters overnight into September 1 after roughly ten drones approached the Estonia-Russia border; one briefly crossed into Estonian airspace near Narva before returning to Russia, while Latvia issued and later lifted an airspace warning for Alūksne municipality with no confirmed incursion. In Bucharest on September 3, European Council President António Costa told President Nicușor Dan that 'the latest violations of Romania's airspace, as well as incidents involving maritime drones, are deeply concerning,' pledging that 'the security of Romania is Europe's security as well.'
footerNote: Data sourced from official NATO/SHAPE and member-state defense ministry statements, major outlets, and institutional analyses.
